Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[This Is Just Wrong]] and [[This Is Still Wrong]]: Leia kisses Luke in the medical center of the Rebel base on Hoth in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), after saying "Why, I guess you don't know everything about women yet?", while Han Solo watches with his arms folded and Chewbacca and C-3PO look on. Cropped to the picture area (the letterbox bars removed) and reduced to 1000 by 433 pixels.

Source: a frame at 0:59 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONEwpPsaIjE Luke tells Leia she's his sister], Kaotiqx, YouTube (23 July 2020), a fan clip that follows the scene in ''Return of the Jedi'' (1983) where Luke tells Leia that she is his sister with this shot from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), directed by Irvin Kershner, Lucasfilm. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027123819/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONEwpPsaIjE Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced frame from the film, showing the scene that the card [[This Is Just Wrong]] quotes and pictures, the work the cards refer to. It is used only to identify that scene beside the cards on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
